dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The dorsal region exhibits approximately 4-5 prominent, irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. These feature a sharp gradient transition from dark-pixel exterior coats to thin, high-intensity light perimeters. The internal regions of these annuli consist of textured, mid-intensity pixels that are darker than the perimeter line but lighter than the primary base coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a low to moderate spatial density of small, asymmetrical, solid high-intensity pixel clusters located primarily in the interstices between the larger macro-annuli and along the lateral mid-section. These clusters appear as concentrated points of high-intensity pixels without internal gradient variations.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral. The long axis of this geometric relationship is oriented longitudinally along the dorsal midline, with the most posterior pair of centroids positioned at a closer relative distance to each other than the anterior pair.
